newsitem.title: USA: Ha-Lo, Champion in exclusive deal.
newsitem.headline: Ha-Lo, Champion in exclusive deal.

text.p: Ha-Lo Industries Inc and Champion Products Inc, a division of Sara Lee Corp, said Wednesday they entered into an exclusive distribution agreement.
Under the deal, Ha-Lo has the exclusive rights to sell branded Champion apparel to the corporate promotional market.
Ha-Lo, which distributes advertising specialty and promotional products, said it distributes to corporations across the United States.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
"There is substantial unfilled demand for superior promotional products in the corporate marketplace," Lou Weisbach, Ha-Lo's president and chief executive, said in a statement.
Based in Winston-Salem, N.C., Champion provides branded athletic sports apparel.
"Champion...is now poised to capitalize on the growing market demand for high-quality branded apparel for corporate promotional use," Michael Flatow, president of Champion, said in a news release.
"We expect Champion's sales opportunities and growth potential to be substantial," he said.
Ha-Lo, based in Niles, Ill., has about 700 sales representatives.
